_doc: The look (style/style_spec.md). Colours are sRGB hex; the certificate prints in two inks on cream paper, as two-colour certificates of the 1860s-1890s did: the green plate (border, guilloche, counters, underprint) and the sepia plate (vignettes, type, rules).

sheet._note: Letter, landscape: the printed prop (brief, 'The prop') and the render share one layout. 4400 x 3400 px.

light._note: Calibrated so the paper under the key renders at about its printed colour (#EEE5CC) in the Standard view (C1 drafts).
